description: Canonical token values for the terminal design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: Amber counts render as text on the page.

Terminal inputs are identified by the bold '$' prompt glyph in accent (JSX TextInput contract: 'Must display $ prompt prefix', plus the blinking cursor), not by a stroke: the dashed #1F2F1F rule above the composer is a section divider. WCAG 1.4.11 asks for 3:1 on what identifies the control, so the prompt glyph (text, 4.5:1) is checked in place of border_input on surface (1.28:1). (#7)

color.surface.note: JSX colour swatch 'Surface #111811'. The live chat currently paints every region on page_bg (#0A0F0A).

color.surface_selected.note: Selection is signalled by the '>' prompt character and a text-colour shift; there is no selection fill, so this equals page_bg.

color.surface_inverse.note: Reverse video: text_primary as the fill, page colour as the text.

color.text_placeholder.note: Live CSS: input placeholder is text_primary at opacity 0.4.

color.accent_foreground.note: Phosphor green is never a fill in the JSX; reverse video uses the page colour.

color.success.note: Phosphor green doubles as the success signal; no separate green in the palette.

color.danger_foreground.note: Status colours are bright on near-black; fills reverse to the page colour.

color.warning.note: JSX 'Amber / Count' — counts, warnings and attention markers.

type.title.note: Terminal's scale is flat; title aliases display (14px/700).

space.md.note: Not named in JSX; 14px is the recurring sidebar/message gutter.

motion.fast.note: Control feedback is instant: hover fills and selection have no transition ('Transition: Instant — no animation'). The CSS block defines '.snd { transition: transform 0.1s }' but no Terminal element uses class snd. The blinking cursor runs at this tier with a 1s step-end timing override (spec motion.elements.cursor).

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s linear', 40ms stagger. Lines print; they do not leave, so exit_ms 0 is derived.

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.25s linear', 60ms stagger (doc row: 250ms linear). Contradicts the JSX prose 'no transitions longer than 150ms'. exit_ms 0 derived.

motion.expressive.note: No expressive motion: the cursor is 'the only allowed motion in Terminal'. Repeats slow.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Terminal's grammar is near-instant, so reduced motion makes every transition instant and stops the cursor blink (solid █).

color.border_input.note: Not the control boundary: inputs are identified by the $ prompt glyph (contrast_pairs entry that replaces border_input on surface, #7); #1F2F1F stays the dashed section rule.
